description: This file defines an abstract base class for non-cryptographic hash algorithms within the Orleans project. It provides the core interface and utility methods for classes that implement specific hashing algorithms, including methods for appending data, obtaining the hash, and resetting state.

classes.name: NonCryptographicHashAlgorithm
classes.description: An abstract class representing a non-cryptographic hash algorithm, providing common functionality and interface methods for derived hash algorithm classes.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends data from a byte array to the hash computation.

methods.name: GetHashAndReset

methods.name: GetHashAndReset
